claims.claim: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() discarded the explicit project-trust decision by forcing the settings manager back to untrusted after the bootstrap extension pass, so a trusted project never got its project-local extensions or project settings.
The repair applies the resolved decision (true or false) before reloading settings and resolving final resources, keeping the bootstrap pass untrusted.

validation.notes: The regression loads the real DefaultResourceLoader (packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts) together with the real SettingsManager (packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts) through .prale-eval/subject.mjs, using an in-memory SettingsStorage and boundary fakes for the package manager, extension loader and path/text helpers. The fake package manager only exposes the project extension when the settings manager currently reports the project as trusted, so the observed extension set reveals the trust state at each resolution. Scenario 'trusted': the bootstrap pass must see an untrusted settings manager and only the user extension; the resolveProjectTrust callback then receives that bootstrap result; after reload the settings manager is trusted, the project settings (theme) are loaded, the final resource resolution sees the trusted state plus settings written during the prompt (proving settings were reloaded before final resolution), the project and user extensions are both loaded, and the user extension is loaded exactly once. Scenario 'untrusted': the explicit false decision stays untrusted, project settings stay out, the final resolution stays untrusted and only the user extension is loaded. Verified detection: temporarily restoring the original line `this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false)` makes the script exit 1 with assertion failures ('trusted decision is applied to the settings manager', 'trusted project settings are loaded', 'settings are reloaded before the final resource resolution', 'project extensions load once the project is trusted'); with the repair it exits 0. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts) could not be executed because node_modules is not installed and dependencies must not be installed, so validation is the standalone VM-module regression only.
